# Plane 3 exceptions (spec 008, TP-209.1, D-3, RF-10.5), read by
# `parity_bench check` (AYTHER Engine). Golden = libretro gpgx, candidate =
# tessera_native, every ROM registered in tools/diffbench/CMakeLists.txt, 8
# frames from power-on with a neutral pad.
#
#   <rom> <frame> <subplane> <EXC-nnn>
#
# rom: a catalogued ROM or `*`; frame: N, N-M or `*` (every dumped frame).
# Strict accounting: the check fails on a divergence no line declares AND on a
# declared tuple that no longer diverges, so an exception that a fix retires
# must be deleted here and in docs/parity-exceptions.md. Every id is a row of
# docs/parity-exceptions.md.

# EXC-008: PCM at 48 kHz (Tessera) vs 44.1 kHz (gpgx); never equal by design.
* * pcm EXC-008

# EXC-001: chip_writes differs only in `cycle`; chip_seq is identical.
fm-psg-0 2-8 chip_writes EXC-001
fm-psg-1 2-8 chip_writes EXC-001
fm-psg-2 2-8 chip_writes EXC-001
fm-psg-3 2-8 chip_writes EXC-001
fm-psg-4 2-8 chip_writes EXC-001
fm-psg-0-once 1-2 chip_writes EXC-001
fm-psg-1-once 1 chip_writes EXC-001
fm-psg-2-once 1 chip_writes EXC-001
fm-psg-3-once 1 chip_writes EXC-001
ym-busy-0 1 chip_writes EXC-001
ym-busy-1 1 chip_writes EXC-001
ym-busy-2 1 chip_writes EXC-001
ym-busy-3 1 chip_writes EXC-001
ym-busy-4 1 chip_writes EXC-001
ym-busy-8 1 chip_writes EXC-001
z80-bank-0 2 chip_writes EXC-001
z80-bank-2 2 chip_writes EXC-001
z80-bank-3 2 chip_writes EXC-001
z80-bank-4 2 chip_writes EXC-001

modes-sweep-3 2 palette EXC-007

# EXC-010: Mode 5 <-> Mode 4 switch frame (raster reasons, mid-line palette).
mode4-scene-1 1 raster EXC-010
mode4-scene-2 1 raster EXC-010
mode4-scene-3 1 raster EXC-010

# EXC-011: dma_fifo frame 1, gpgx 0x10 vs Tessera 0x40 (cause not diagnosed).
dma_fifo 1 raster EXC-011

# EXC-012: H32 lines inside an H40 frame, columns 256-319.
raster-bands-7 2-8 fb EXC-012
raster-bands-7 2-8 tiles EXC-012
